scope: Reference for implemented read-only adapters in src/reader.js and both UI entry points. No signing integration.

read_signatures: function allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns (uint256)

activation.address_policy: Resolve emissions.activation() each session; this address is the historical snapshot value.

read_signatures: function listings(uint8 itemId) view returns (uint256 price, uint32 maxSupply, uint32 sold, uint8 slot, bool listed)
function balanceOf(address account, uint256 id) view returns (uint256)

names.note: Published address; inspected client has an environment-dependent zero-address fallback. Not validated here.

charter.note: Separate soulbound collectible, not one of the 3333 farm plots. Do not assume a yield boost.

abi_caution: Signatures are from the public client, except the standard decimals getter checked by RPC. Only calls in the snapshot have block-pinned evidence here. Snapshot values are integers; CROP uses 18 decimals and displayed weight/weather use BPS.

api_endpoints.notes: Observed aggregate JSON. No block tag in observed response; freshness and ratePerSecWei base-versus-weather semantics are unverified. Do not apply weather twice.
Unrevealed is an explicit status, never Common by default. Metadata ID 1 is only a public research example.

Cached bytes were matched to the recorded chain commitment using Keccak-256; recheck on changed bytes/deployment. Token mapping is unknown until reveal. Use manifest row, not source_row, in reveal mapping.
Observed in follow-up; agrees with sampled current chain weather but has no block tag. Not a future-weather reveal.

refresh_policy.rules: Local first; recheck only relevant rule on changed deployment, reported change or conflict.
refresh_policy.chain_state: Implemented block-pinned public reads. Browser polling is opt-in every 30 seconds while visible and not editing; CLI monitoring is separately opt-in. Record timestamp and block.
refresh_policy.api_state: Store response time separately. Compare against chain data; missing/errors are not zero.
refresh_policy.quotes: Get fresh executable-size quotes when estimating buys/sales/transfers, including wallet-paid costs. No live price assumed in this package.
refresh_policy.manifest: Cached for offline use. Re-fetch on changed commitment/file, and resolve token mapping only after reveal.
refresh_policy.future_weeks: Use revealed data only; a commitment is not a weather forecast.
refresh_policy.season: src/season.js reads weather, epochs, events, registered moon starts, commitment, NFT supply and total weight without any wallet address. Pin all reads to one block. Read current weatherOf only; future getter defaults are not reveal evidence. CLI: node tools/season.mjs. Legacy NFT PRICE()/saleState() probes reverted on 2026-09-07; do not use these to establish mint availability or price.

shared_data_contract.amounts: Nonnegative decimal integer strings for *_wei fields; signed net-profit results may be negative.
shared_data_contract.unknown: null, accompanied by missing input/evidence notes; no default rarity, zero balance or free fee.
shared_data_contract.result: Implemented in src/engine.js: status, scenario/horizon, earned/spent/bought CROP, liquid/pending/ending balances, purchases, wallet-paid fees, operating ETH, cash recovery, optional NFT-inclusive estimate, per-wallet actions and assumptions. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
